title: Shifting Focus by Reliability: Geometric Fusion Modulation for Robust RGB-T Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.41204v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: RGB-thermal (RGB-T) object detectors combine visible and thermal imagery for robust detection, but signal corruption in either stream can substantially degrade accuracy. Restoration-based methods incur significant latency and do not consistently improve downstream accuracy, raising a more direct question: rather than restoring corrupted inputs, can we efficiently adapt the detector to their varying signal quality? Conventional PEFT offers an efficient route, but its input-independent corrections cannot track diverse test-time corruptions. Our controlled corruption sweeps show that corruption types have similar effects near clean conditions but diverge increasingly with severity, motivating corruption-aware, per-input adaptation. We therefore propose PG-FM (Prompt-Guided Feature Modulation), which adapts RGB-T object detectors to the estimated corruption type and severity of each modality. translated_title: 基于可靠性的焦点转移：面向鲁棒RGB-T检测的几何融合调制
translated_abstract: RGB-热（RGB-T）目标检测器通过结合可见光与热成像图像实现鲁棒检测，但任一模态流中的信号损坏都会显著降低检测精度。基于图像恢复的方法会带来显著的推理延迟，且并不总能改善下游检测精度，这引出了一个更直接的问题：与其恢复受损的输入，我们能否高效地让检测器自适应地应对其变化的信号质量？传统的参数高效微调（PEFT）提供了一条高效途径，但其与输入无关的修正无法跟踪多样的测试时损坏情况。我们通过受控的损坏扫描实验发现，各类损坏在接近干净条件下影响相似，但随严重程度的增加而日益分化，这促使我们采用损坏感知的逐输入自适应方式。因此，我们提出了PG-FM（提示引导的特征调制），使RGB-T目标检测器能够根据每个模态所估计的损坏类型和严重程度进行自适应调整。在受控的RGB-T损坏模拟下，
tldr: 提出提示引导的特征调制方法PG-FM，无需恢复受损输入，即可让RGB-T目标检测器根据各模态估计的损坏类型与严重程度进行逐输入自适应，实现鲁棒检测。
en_tdlr: PG-FM (Prompt-Guided Feature Modulation) enables RGB-T object detectors to adapt per-input to the estimated corruption type and severity of each modality, achieving robust detection without restoring corrupted inputs.
